name: kotlin
description: Tight verify loop for Kotlin/Android/Gradle repos — the cargo/clippy counterpart to the flutter skill. One-command gate (everything attached to Gradle `check`), zero-warning strictness (ktlint, detekt, Android Lint, allWarningsAsErrors), narrow-first cadence, plus a Roborazzi headless screenshot rig so UI decisions come from pixels. Use whenever editing Kotlin or Gradle files, before committing Kotlin work, when a strict lint/test gate is red, and for any Compose UI/UX/layout task.
author: jtrv
